baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَا يَسْأَمُ ... مِن دُعَاءِ الْخَيْرِ / وَإِن مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَيَئُوسٌ قَنُوطٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah opposes high tolerance for repeated benefit-seeking to extreme sensitivity to adverse contact: prolonged calling never produces fatigue, while evil need only reach the person as an effect before two hope-cutting predicates turn a local event into a terminal verdict.

activation_trace.role: Weariness from prolonged stay or repetition supplies the duration threshold that repeated good-seeking never reaches.
Calling and inclining by speech makes good the object repeatedly summoned toward the caller.
Desired benefit supplies the attractive pole that sustains the repeated call.
Being reached by an effect makes mere adverse incidence, not prolonged immersion, the collapse threshold.
Evil or harm supplies the adverse pole opposed to the continually requested benefit.
Cutting off expectation converts a bounded adverse contact into a verdict about the whole future.
A second image of severed hope intensifies and stabilizes the terminal reaction.

changed_reading.before: The human likes good and becomes sad when bad happens.
changed_reading.after: The ayah diagnoses a threshold asymmetry: desire tolerates indefinite repetition, but a minimal adverse contact is totalized into a double severance of hope.

baseline_models.mechanism: The call can carry not only petition but claim: the human repeatedly selects benefit, treats gift as something due, and therefore experiences adverse contact as a breach of an expected entitlement rather than simply an unwanted event.

activation_trace.role: Claiming a right or attribution lets the call function as repeated appropriation, not only vocal request.
Choosing and seeking what is deemed better supplies the caller's self-selected object.
Gift and generosity make the selected good something received that can be misclassified as owed.
Adverse incidence punctures the expected stream of personally claimed benefit.
The abrupt cutting of expectation is the affective result of the entitlement breach.

changed_reading.before: The phrase describes persistent prayer for good.
changed_reading.after: It can also expose a renewable claim on self-selected benefit, making despair the reaction to an entitlement that reality fails to honor.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, warning is turned away from, not understood or obeyed, weighted out at the ear, and blocked by a barrier, even as the same call-root names what the messenger directs them toward. The focus then presents a human who never tires of calling good toward himself: communication is energetically open outbound for benefit but deliberately closed inbound for correction.

activation_trace.role: The focus call supplies the tireless outbound demand for benefit.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the corrective message the human needs before evil arrives.
Turning one's side supplies the active refusal of the warning channel.
Hearing as understanding and compliance shows that the blocked reception is functional, not merely acoustic.
The repeated call-root marks the incoming invitation that is rejected while outbound benefit-calling remains tireless.
Weight in the ear materializes resistance in the receiving channel.
Prevention of access completes the one-way communication mechanism.

structural_cues: 41:4-5 sequences warning, turning away, failed hearing, ear-weight, and a barrier around an incoming call.
The focus reuses د ع و for the human's own unwearied call for benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed incoming and outgoing calls plus explicit reception barriers; I infer a one-way demand system whose lack of corrective intake helps make adverse contact shocking. A live alternative is that the two calling scenes concern different groups and need not describe one psychology.

changed_reading.before: The human is simply persistent in asking for good.
changed_reading.after: The persistence is communicatively asymmetric: tireless as claimant, the human has screened out the warning that could have made evil bearable without total despair.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah places measured sustenance in creation before naming its askers. That order dislodges an implicit causal fantasy in tireless دعاء الخير: calling does not manufacture provision; it addresses a supply already measured and maintained, so despair at interruption also reveals failure to trust a provisioning timescale outside the caller's repetition.

activation_trace.role: Repeated calling supplies the human attempt to draw benefit toward himself.
Useful benefit is the requested object whose source is being reconsidered.
Deliberate apportionment supplies an ordering of provision independent of the caller's persistence.
Sustenance that keeps life going supplies the concrete good already placed in the created order.
Asking and requesting explicitly places seekers after the statement of measured provision.

structural_cues: 41:9-10 narrates creation and apportionment before ending with the askers.
The focus reverses attention onto the duration of asking rather than the prior measure of what is sought.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured sustenance and askers in that sequence; I infer that pre-provisioning weakens the imagined arrow from repeated asking to production of good. Alternatively, للسائلين may identify recipients or inquirers without making any claim about trust or causality.

changed_reading.before: Unwearied petition is the engine by which the human pursues good.
changed_reading.after: The petition sits downstream of measured provision; its compulsiveness and despair disclose mistrust of an order the call does not control.

context_deltas.mechanism: A nearby positive sequence does not abolish desire or repeated claim: upright constancy is followed by protective companionship and by whatever selves desire and claim. This preserves appetite but places it inside a stable relation and promised horizon, distinguishing desire itself from the focus human's stimulus-driven collapse.

activation_trace.role: Freedom from fatigue marks the focus subject's open-ended capacity to keep wanting.
Calling supplies the appetite whose moral and temporal framing changes in context.
Uprightness and equilibrium supply a stable posture across changing circumstances.
Protective love and support supply a relation that can hold desire without panic.
Desire after desire shows that recurring appetite is retained rather than erased.
Claims or called-for things are granted within the promised horizon, rehabilitating the claim-root under a different posture.

structural_cues: 41:30-32 joins constancy, removal of fear and grief, companionship, recurring desire, granted claims, and hospitality.
The focus retains desire and calling but lacks the stabilizing posture named in that sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies constancy, support, desire, and granted claims; I infer that a stable horizon contains appetite and prevents a passing evil from becoming final. A live alternative is that the promised subjects are categorically different, so their desire should contrast with rather than rehabilitate the focus desire.

changed_reading.before: Endless desire is itself the diagnosed defect.
changed_reading.after: The sharper defect is endless desire without constancy, support, or a horizon long enough to prevent adverse contact from totalizing the future.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's فـ routes adverse touch directly into despair, but the surah has already supplied two alternative response circuits: move an evil away by the better until hostility changes relation, and answer incitement by taking refuge. Evil is therefore not only an outcome to endure; it is an input whose downstream routing can be transformed.

activation_trace.role: Adverse incidence supplies the triggering input in the focus circuit.
Severed expectation is the focus circuit's immediate output.
What causes distress supplies a contextual counterpart to the focus evil.
Moving the harmful thing aside supplies an active alternative routing.
Doing the better supplies the transforming counter-input that can change hostility into closeness.
Incitement that corrupts relations supplies another adverse stimulus before response is chosen.
Refuge and protective attachment supply a second non-despair response path.

structural_cues: 41:34 explicitly turns an adverse relation into intimate alliance through a better response.
41:36 gives an if-then response to incitement, while 41:49 gives a different if-then response to evil's touch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three adverse-input clauses with different outputs; I infer that their juxtaposition exposes despair as a routing pattern rather than an inevitable property of harm. Alternatively, interpersonal evil and satanic incitement may be narrower domains than the focus's general الشر.

changed_reading.before: Despair naturally follows when evil reaches the human.
changed_reading.after: The ayah displays one maladaptive routing of adverse contact; elsewhere the same surah routes disturbance into transformation or refuge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact negated weariness verb has already described uninterrupted night-and-day glorification. Repetition itself is therefore neutral: heavenly servants sustain ceaseless giving of praise, while the focus human sustains ceaseless drawing of benefit. The object and direction of tirelessness, not stamina alone, become diagnostic.

activation_trace.role: The focus's immunity to fatigue marks endurance specifically in repeated benefit-calling.
Calling good toward oneself gives the focus endurance its acquisitive direction.
Worship through glorification supplies the giving-oriented repeated act in the comparison.
The same non-fatigue image across night and day creates the direct contextual control for the focus phrase.

structural_cues: 41:38 and 41:49 repeat the same negated weariness lexeme.
Night and day make the first repetition explicitly continuous; دعاء الخير specifies the second repetition's object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact echo and different repeated acts; I infer a directional contrast between sustained praise and sustained acquisition. A live alternative is that the echo only intensifies each scene separately without inviting a taxonomy of tirelessness.

changed_reading.before: Not tiring is merely an emphatic way to describe strong appetite.
changed_reading.after: Not tiring becomes an orientation test: endless repetition can be constancy in praise or insatiability in drawing good toward the self.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus block, low, inert earth receives water, moves, rises, and lives; deathlike appearance is a reversible phase containing latent response. Against that material sequence, evil's mere touch followed by severed hope is not only emotional excess but an epistemic error: the human reads the present surface as the whole lifecycle.

activation_trace.role: A reached effect supplies the local present condition that the human overreads.
Cutting expectation converts that present condition into a closed future.
The doubled severance confirms that reversibility has disappeared from the human's model.
Low, inert earth supplies a surface state that looks exhausted without being terminal.
Delivered water supplies the external condition that releases the hidden transition.
Earth and vegetation stirring with life supplies the first visible reversal.
Increase and rising supply expansion after apparent depletion.
Earth's life through rain and growth supplies the completed recovery model.
Lifeless earth supplies the strongest apparently terminal state that the sequence nevertheless reverses.

structural_cues: 41:39 compresses apparent depletion and revival into a single إذا transition.
The focus also uses an if-clause but maps contact directly to two terminal predicates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a reversible material lifecycle and the focus supplies a terminal affective inference; I map the lifecycle onto the human's horizon of expectation. Alternatively, the earth sequence may concern resurrection alone and need not diagnose ordinary responses to harm.

changed_reading.before: Despair is the intensity of pain after evil arrives.
changed_reading.after: Despair is also a false model of time: it mistakes a touched, barren-looking phase for a future in which no life can emerge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah makes formerly invoked objects go missing and removes any route of evasion. The focus's unwearied calling can thus be heard against a failed address system: repetition cannot secure good when the invoked support disappears, and despair exposes how completely expectation had been lodged in that unreliable addressee.

activation_trace.role: The focus's repeated call supplies the persistent attempt to draw good from an addressee.
Cut expectation supplies the collapse when the address system fails.
Loss of the formerly invoked object supplies the disappearance of the expected responder.
The same calling image links the lost supports directly to the focus's benefit-calling.
No turning aside or alternate direction removes an escape route when the invoked support is absent.

structural_cues: 41:48 immediately precedes the focus and repeats the call-root.
Loss of the invoked objects and absence of an exit are followed by tireless calling and then hopelessness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, repeated calling, missing invoked objects, and no alternate direction; I infer that unreliable address helps explain the abrupt collapse. A live alternative is that 41:48 concerns false partners specifically while 41:49 generalizes human appetite without carrying over an addressee.

changed_reading.before: The human despairs because the desired good is delayed.
changed_reading.after: The despair may disclose a deeper address failure: the human has made good depend on a support that vanishes when adverse reality arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah tests the focus's entitlement model: after harm has touched him, a tasted mercy is verbally converted into possession, then projected into guaranteed ultimate good. A sample of experience is not held as a sample; benefit becomes 'mine,' while adversity becomes total despair.

activation_trace.role: Claiming a right makes the focus call available as the antecedent of the later possession statement.
Gift and generosity supply what can be received as mercy but appropriated as personal due.
Adverse incidence supplies the experience that first produces despair and is then recalled in the next ayah.
Experiencing and testing frames mercy and punishment as tasted samples rather than complete ownership of an outcome.
Merciful tenderness supplies the received benefit that the speaker reclassifies as his own.
Loss or deficiency supplies the adverse state explicitly linked to the focus's touch construction.
The repeated touch image binds the next ayah's experiential sequence to the focus reaction.
Speech as belief or doctrine makes 'this is mine' an expressed ownership model, not a passing exclamation only.
Uncertain supposition supplies the speculative leap from present taste to denial of the Hour.
The best or beautiful outcome supplies the future benefit the speaker awards himself as well.

structural_cues: 41:50 repeats harm's touch, then places mercy-tasting before 'this is mine.'
The speaker denies the Hour yet assigns himself the best outcome if returned, extending present appropriation into the future.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies taste, touch, possession speech, supposition, and self-assigned final good; I infer a sample-to-total and gift-to-entitlement arrow. Alternatively, 'this is mine' could merely report current possession, though its coupling to the claimed final good keeps entitlement live.

changed_reading.before: The human repeatedly asks for benefit and despairs when benefit stops.
changed_reading.after: The human converts each favorable sample into owned entitlement and each adverse sample into a total future, explaining both the tireless claim and the instant collapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The second following ayah repeats human, evil, touch, and prayer but replaces the focus's apparent endpoint with 'broad prayer.' Its doubled ع ر ض root also yokes turning aside under favor to width under harm. Despair therefore need not silence petition: inward severance of hope can coexist with, or even drive, outward verbal expansion.

activation_trace.role: Cut expectation supplies the inward state that initially looks like the end of petition.
The doubled hope-severance intensifies the apparent contradiction with later broad prayer.
Good condition and favor supply the circumstance under which the human withdraws rather than calls.
Turning the side supplies contraction and withdrawal under favor.
Width and side supply the opposed spatial expansion of prayer under harm through the same root occurrence set.
Drawing the side far away sharpens the favored human's receptive withdrawal.
The exact adverse-incidence image reopens the same trigger as the focus.
The exact evil image confirms that the later prayer expansion answers the same adverse pole.
Vocal calling supplies the outwardly broad activity that coexists with inward hopelessness.

structural_cues: 41:51 exactly reprises الإنسان, مس, الشر, and دعاء within two ayat of the focus.
The same ع ر ض occurrence record covers turning away and broadness, producing a contraction-expansion reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact lexical reprise plus spatial withdrawal under favor and verbal width under harm; I infer coexistence between despair and abundant petition. A live alternative is temporal: broad prayer may come first and the focus's despair may describe the state reached after it appears unanswered.

changed_reading.before: Evil's touch replaces prayer with hopeless silence.
changed_reading.after: Evil's touch can sever hope internally while expanding prayer externally; favor contracts reception, whereas distress makes speech broad.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps botanical enclosure and pregnancy onto delayed good; it remains anchored in the focus's good, touch, and hope-cutting and is supported by explicit images of hidden fruit and inner carrying. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for unseen maturation, not as a lexical definition of دعاء الخير.

activation_trace.role: Desired benefit supplies the apparently absent outcome whose status is questioned.
Present adverse incidence supplies the visible surface from which the human infers absence of future good.
Cutting expectation supplies the premature closure before hidden production emerges.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the transition from hidden process to visible outcome.
Ripe fruit supplies a concrete beneficial result that appears only after maturation.
The plant vessel and fruit-cover supply a state in which an outcome exists but is not yet exposed.
Inner carrying of pregnancy or fruit supplies a second hidden-development container.
Delivery at birth supplies the release point that follows concealed carrying.

changed_reading.before: No visible good after harm means the requested good is gone.
changed_reading.after: The packet permits an exploratory gestation model: apparent absence may be enclosure before emergence, so despair aborts the temporal reading before hidden good can come out.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it spatializes affect and divine knowledge; it remains valid as a diagnostic analogy because the packet explicitly supplies touch, distant horizons, doubt, and complete enclosure. Downstream prose should qualify the contrast as reader-supplied geometry, not claim that the ayah equates these roots.

activation_trace.role: Tactile contact supplies a boundary-local image for evil's arrival.
Severed expectation turns a local contact into closure of the whole future.
Repeated hope-cutting reinforces the false global enclosure.
Far horizons supply the wider field omitted when one touched point dominates judgment.
Doubt and wavering supply the unstable cognition within which local contact is overgeneralized.
Sensory enclosure supplies the spatial counter-image to mere boundary contact.
Complete enclosure in knowledge supplies the larger totality that exceeds the human's adverse sample.

changed_reading.before: The touched evil accurately encloses the human's prospects.
changed_reading.after: A local boundary event has been mistaken for the whole horizon, while the surah's final enclosure belongs to comprehensive knowledge rather than to the passing evil.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it borrows residual milk and sequential falling as process images for prayer; it remains anchored entirely in the focus call, good, repetition, and doubled despair and yields a coherent feedback mechanism. Downstream prose should label it an exploratory material model, not a preferred semantic gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لَا يَسْأَمُ ... مِن دُعَاءِ الْخَيْرِ ... فَيَئُوسٌ قَنُوطٌ

activation_trace.role: Lack of fatigue under repetition allows the feedback cycle to continue without satiety.
Milk left behind to call forth what follows supplies a starter image in which one received good recruits the next request.
Gift and generosity supply each benefit that becomes starter for another cycle.
One part falling after another supplies the reversal from benefit recruitment into cascading collapse.
The first cut in expectation begins the adverse feedback cascade.
The second hope-cutting predicate supplies the next fall after the first.

changed_reading.before: Each prayer is an independent request, and the two despair words merely repeat one feeling.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, each good recruits another call, but one adverse contact reverses the feedback so one hope-cutting state falls into the next.

strongest_changes: The exact لا يسأمون echo changes tirelessness from raw intensity into a test of whether repetition gives praise or draws benefit toward the self.
41:51 shows that despair does not necessarily end prayer: inward hope can contract while outward petition becomes broad.
41:50 confirms the claim-entitlement branch by converting tasted mercy into 'mine' and projecting it into guaranteed final good.
The reviving earth sequence recasts despair as a false temporal inference from a barren-looking phase.
The early blocked-warning scenes make tireless benefit-calling part of a one-way communication system.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet supplied exact lexical reprises, opposed call directions, alternative adverse-response circuits, and material reversals. Together they changed a generic portrait of fickleness into inspectable models of threshold asymmetry, one-way reception, entitlement, temporal misreading, and prayer that expands even while hope is cut.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether دعاء الخير should foreground vocal petition, claiming a due, or both remains open.
The contrast with 41:38 is mechanically strong but could be an echo without an intended moral taxonomy of non-weariness.
The hidden-gestation, local-touch/global-enclosure, and feedback-chain readings should remain explicitly exploratory analogies.
